ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: /*$Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator' && */ TEXT(Process_Status__c) = 'Payment Details Received' && CONTAINS(TEXT(Type__c), 'EFT') && ( Original_Currency_Acronym__c = 'GBP' || Original_Currency_Acronym__c = 'EUR' || Original_Currency_Acronym__c = 'DKK' ) && ISBLANK(IBAN__c) && ISCHANGED(Process_Status__c)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: IBAN is mandatory for currency GBP, EUR or DKK
